title: 陈桥兵变黄袍加身
summary: 赵匡胤在陈桥驿被部下黄袍加身拥立为帝，建立宋朝。
summaryEn: Zhao Kuangyin was draped in the imperial yellow robe by his troops and proclaimed emperor, founding Song.
description: 赵匡胤在陈桥驿被部下黄袍加身拥立为帝，建立宋朝。
descriptionEn: Zhao Kuangyin was draped in the imperial yellow robe by his troops and proclaimed emperor, founding Song.

title: 杯酒释兵权
summary: 赵匡胤以宴请方式和平解除了开国将领的军权，避免重蹈五代军人专权的覆辙。
summaryEn: Zhao Kuangyin peacefully retired his founding generals over a banquet, preventing the cycle of military coups.
description: 赵匡胤以宴请方式和平解除了开国将领的军权，避免重蹈五代军人专权的覆辙。
descriptionEn: Zhao Kuangyin peacefully retired his founding generals over a banquet, preventing the cycle of military coups.

title: 赵匡胤统一南方
summary: 采取「先南后北」战略，先后灭荆南、后蜀、南汉、南唐等割据政权。
summaryEn: Adopting a 'south first' strategy, Zhao successively conquered Jingnan, Later Shu, Southern Han, and Southern Tang.
description: 采取「先南后北」战略，先后灭荆南、后蜀、南汉、南唐等割据政权。
descriptionEn: Adopting a 'south first' strategy, Zhao successively conquered Jingnan, Later Shu, Southern Han, and Southern Tang.

title: 斧声烛影——宋太宗即位
summary: 太祖暴毙之夜「斧声烛影」疑云重重，其弟赵光义即位为宋太宗。
summaryEn: On the night of Taizu's sudden death, shrouded in mystery, his brother Zhao Guangyi ascended.
description: 太祖暴毙之夜「斧声烛影」疑云重重，其弟赵光义即位为宋太宗。
descriptionEn: On the night of Taizu's sudden death, shrouded in mystery, his brother Zhao Guangyi ascended.

title: 灭北汉与高梁河之败
titleEn: Destruction of Northern Han & Gaoliang Defeat
summary: 赵光义亲征灭北汉完成统一，但随后北伐辽国在高梁河大败，本人中箭乘驴车逃走。
summaryEn: Zhao Guangyi destroyed Northern Han, but his northern expedition against Liao ended in disaster at Gaoliang River.
description: 赵光义亲征灭北汉完成统一，但随后北伐辽国在高梁河大败，本人中箭乘驴车逃走。
descriptionEn: Zhao Guangyi destroyed Northern Han, but his northern expedition against Liao ended in disaster at Gaoliang River.

title: 赵普——半部《论语》治天下
titleEn: Zhao Pu: Half the Analects to Govern
summary: 赵普是宋朝开国第一功臣，策划陈桥兵变、设计杯酒释兵权，三次拜相。
summaryEn: Zhao Pu was Song's founding strategist, architect of the coup and the wine-dismissal, serving as chancellor three times.
description: 赵普是宋朝开国第一功臣，策划陈桥兵变、设计杯酒释兵权，三次拜相。
descriptionEn: Zhao Pu was Song's founding strategist, architect of the coup and the wine-dismissal, serving as chancellor three times.

title: 寇准力主亲征与澶渊之盟
titleEn: Kou Zhun and the Chanyuan Treaty
summary: 辽军南侵时满朝恐慌，寇准力排众议坚持宋真宗御驾亲征，最终达成澶渊之盟换取了百年和平。
summaryEn: When Liao invaded, Kou Zhun insisted the emperor personally lead the defense, resulting in the Chanyuan Treaty.
description: 辽军南侵时满朝恐慌，寇准力排众议坚持宋真宗御驾亲征，最终达成澶渊之盟换取了百年和平。
descriptionEn: When Liao invaded, Kou Zhun insisted the emperor personally lead the defense, resulting in the Chanyuan Treaty.

title: 毕昇发明活字印刷术
summary: 平民毕昇发明泥活字印刷术，用胶泥刻字火烧硬化排版印刷，比古腾堡铅活字早约400年。
summaryEn: Bi Sheng invented movable type with fired clay characters, predating Gutenberg's press by about 400 years.
description: 平民毕昇发明泥活字印刷术，用胶泥刻字火烧硬化排版印刷，比古腾堡铅活字早约400年。
descriptionEn: Bi Sheng invented movable type with fired clay characters, predating Gutenberg's press by about 400 years.

title: 范仲淹断齑画粥
summary: 范仲淹两岁丧父，在醴泉寺刻苦读书，每天只煮一锅粥划为四块早晚各吃两块。
summaryEn: Orphaned at two, Fan Zhongyan studied under extreme hardship, surviving on one pot of congee divided into four.
description: 范仲淹两岁丧父，在醴泉寺刻苦读书，每天只煮一锅粥划为四块早晚各吃两块。
descriptionEn: Orphaned at two, Fan Zhongyan studied under extreme hardship, surviving on one pot of congee divided into four.

title: 庆历新政
summary: 范仲淹在仁宗支持下推行庆历新政，改革科举整顿吏治，但因触动官僚利益而失败。
summaryEn: Fan Zhongyan launched the Qingli Reforms to overhaul examinations and bureaucracy, but failed against vested interests.
description: 范仲淹在仁宗支持下推行庆历新政，改革科举整顿吏治，但因触动官僚利益而失败。
descriptionEn: Fan Zhongyan launched the Qingli Reforms to overhaul examinations and bureaucracy, but failed against vested interests.

title: 《岳阳楼记》
summary: 被贬后范仲淹写下「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐」——定义了中国士大夫两千年的精神追求。
summaryEn: In exile, Fan wrote: 'Be first to bear the world's troubles, last to enjoy its pleasures' — defining the scholar-official's mission.
description: 被贬后范仲淹写下「先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐」——定义了中国士大夫两千年的精神追求。
descriptionEn: In exile, Fan wrote: 'Be first to bear the world's troubles, last to enjoy its pleasures' — defining the scholar-official's mission.

title: 包拯铁面无私
summary: 包拯以铁面无私刚正不阿著称，是中国文化中「包青天」清官形象的永恒象征。
summaryEn: Bao Zheng, famed for incorruptible justice, became the eternal symbol of the upright official in Chinese culture.
description: 包拯以铁面无私刚正不阿著称，是中国文化中「包青天」清官形象的永恒象征。
descriptionEn: Bao Zheng, famed for incorruptible justice, became the eternal symbol of the upright official in Chinese culture.

title: 宋仁宗——千古仁君
summary: 宋仁宗在位四十二年，是宋朝文治的巅峰期，包拯、范仲淹、欧阳修、苏轼等群星璀璨。
summaryEn: Renzong's 42-year reign was the zenith of Song civil governance, producing an extraordinary constellation of talents.
description: 宋仁宗在位四十二年，是宋朝文治的巅峰期，包拯、范仲淹、欧阳修、苏轼等群星璀璨。
descriptionEn: Renzong's 42-year reign was the zenith of Song civil governance, producing an extraordinary constellation of talents.

title: 苏颂建造水运仪象台
titleEn: Su Song Builds the Cosmic Engine
summary: 苏颂主持建造了水运仪象台——世界上最古老的天文钟，集观测、演示、报时于一体。
summaryEn: Su Song built the Cosmic Engine — the world's oldest astronomical clock tower, integrating observation and timekeeping.
description: 苏颂主持建造了水运仪象台——世界上最古老的天文钟，集观测、演示、报时于一体。
descriptionEn: Su Song built the Cosmic Engine — the world's oldest astronomical clock tower, integrating observation and timekeeping.

title: 宋神宗与熙宁变法
summary: 宋神宗任用王安石推行大规模熙宁变法，力图富国强兵，新旧党争成为北宋后期政治主线。
summaryEn: Emperor Shenzong appointed Wang Anshi to implement sweeping reforms, dividing the court into reform and conservative factions.
description: 宋神宗任用王安石推行大规模熙宁变法，力图富国强兵，新旧党争成为北宋后期政治主线。
descriptionEn: Emperor Shenzong appointed Wang Anshi to implement sweeping reforms, dividing the court into reform and conservative factions.

title: 宋徽宗的艺术帝国
summary: 宋徽宗是中国历史上艺术造诣最高的皇帝——独创瘦金体、推动翰林图画院，却是灾难性的皇帝。
summaryEn: Huizong was the most artistically accomplished emperor — creating Slender Gold script and the painting academy — but a disastrous ruler.
description: 宋徽宗是中国历史上艺术造诣最高的皇帝——独创瘦金体、推动翰林图画院，却是灾难性的皇帝。
descriptionEn: Huizong was the most artistically accomplished emperor — creating Slender Gold script and the painting academy — but a disastrous ruler.

title: 李清照与赵明诚的金石姻缘
summary: 李清照与丈夫赵明诚共同热衷金石收藏研究，前期词作清新婉约，「知否知否应是绿肥红瘦」。
summaryEn: Li Qingzhao shared a passion for antiquities with her husband; her early lyrics were fresh and graceful.
description: 李清照与丈夫赵明诚共同热衷金石收藏研究，前期词作清新婉约，「知否知否应是绿肥红瘦」。
descriptionEn: Li Qingzhao shared a passion for antiquities with her husband; her early lyrics were fresh and graceful.

title: 南渡——李清照的流亡
summary: 靖康之变后李清照南渡，丈夫去世、毕生收藏散失殆尽，词风转为「寻寻觅觅冷冷清清」的沉痛苍凉。
summaryEn: After the Jingkang Incident, Li Qingzhao fled south — her husband died and her collection was lost; her poetry turned to grief.
description: 靖康之变后李清照南渡，丈夫去世、毕生收藏散失殆尽，词风转为「寻寻觅觅冷冷清清」的沉痛苍凉。
descriptionEn: After the Jingkang Incident, Li Qingzhao fled south — her husband died and her collection was lost; her poetry turned to grief.

title: 张择端绘《清明上河图》
summary: 张择端创作《清明上河图》，以百科全书式的精度记录了12世纪开封的城市生活。
summaryEn: Zhang Zeduan created the iconic scroll recording 12th-century Kaifeng urban life with encyclopedic precision.
description: 张择端创作《清明上河图》，以百科全书式的精度记录了12世纪开封的城市生活。
descriptionEn: Zhang Zeduan created the iconic scroll recording 12th-century Kaifeng urban life with encyclopedic precision.

title: 岳飞北伐
summary: 岳飞率岳家军北伐，郾城大破金军拐子马，打到距开封仅四十五里的朱仙镇。
summaryEn: Yue Fei's army swept north, shattering the Jin at Yancheng and reaching Zhuxian Town, just 45 li from Kaifeng.
description: 岳飞率岳家军北伐，郾城大破金军拐子马，打到距开封仅四十五里的朱仙镇。
descriptionEn: Yue Fei's army swept north, shattering the Jin at Yancheng and reaching Zhuxian Town, just 45 li from Kaifeng.

title: 十二道金牌与风波亭
summary: 宋高宗以十二道金牌强令岳飞班师，随后以「莫须有」罪名在风波亭处死，年仅39岁。
summaryEn: Gaozong recalled Yue Fei with twelve gold medallions, then executed him on fabricated charges at Fengbo Pavilion.
description: 宋高宗以十二道金牌强令岳飞班师，随后以「莫须有」罪名在风波亭处死，年仅39岁。
descriptionEn: Gaozong recalled Yue Fei with twelve gold medallions, then executed him on fabricated charges at Fengbo Pavilion.

title: 宋高宗建立南宋
summary: 靖康之变后赵构在南京应天府即位延续宋朝，后定都临安，开启南宋152年历史。
summaryEn: After the Jingkang Incident, Zhao Gou ascended and later moved the capital to Lin'an, inaugurating Southern Song.
description: 靖康之变后赵构在南京应天府即位延续宋朝，后定都临安，开启南宋152年历史。
descriptionEn: After the Jingkang Incident, Zhao Gou ascended and later moved the capital to Lin'an, inaugurating Southern Song.

title: 陆游——爱国诗人
summary: 陆游是中国存诗最多的诗人之一，85岁临终写下「王师北定中原日，家祭无忘告乃翁」。
summaryEn: Lu You, among China's most prolific poets, wrote on his deathbed: 'When the imperial army recovers the north, tell your father.'
description: 陆游是中国存诗最多的诗人之一，85岁临终写下「王师北定中原日，家祭无忘告乃翁」。
descriptionEn: Lu You, among China's most prolific poets, wrote on his deathbed: 'When the imperial army recovers the north, tell your father.'

title: 辛弃疾——词中之龙
summary: 辛弃疾22岁时率五十骑闯入五万金军大营擒拿叛徒，南归后将满腔悲愤倾注于词。
summaryEn: At 22, Xin Qiji led 50 riders into a 50,000-strong Jin camp to capture a traitor, later pouring his frustration into lyrics.
description: 辛弃疾22岁时率五十骑闯入五万金军大营擒拿叛徒，南归后将满腔悲愤倾注于词。
descriptionEn: At 22, Xin Qiji led 50 riders into a 50,000-strong Jin camp to capture a traitor, later pouring his frustration into lyrics.

title: 文天祥——留取丹心照汗青
titleEn: Wen Tianxiang: A Loyal Heart Illumines History
summary: 南宋灭亡后文天祥被俘，拒绝元朝劝降，在狱中写下《正气歌》后从容就义。
summaryEn: After Song's fall, Wen Tianxiang refused all Yuan offers, wrote 'Song of Righteousness' in prison, and died a martyr.
description: 南宋灭亡后文天祥被俘，拒绝元朝劝降，在狱中写下《正气歌》后从容就义。
descriptionEn: After Song's fall, Wen Tianxiang refused all Yuan offers, wrote 'Song of Righteousness' in prison, and died a martyr.
